The Cross-section tab (DOM):

`src/ui/crossSection/section.ts` (new):

```ts
/**
 * The Cross-section tab of the drawer (SP2b spec §4.5): the columns along the map's cut line A → B at 512
 * points, from one `crossSection` stats job on the pool.
 * - Header: the line (A, B and its length), the status, and the buttons New line (arms the map's cut-line
 *   tool), Clear and Close; a summary line (offset range, water, river channels, gorges, lakes) under it.
 * - Plot (SVG): distance from A on x, blocks on y. The ground under offset; offset ± σ as a band around the
 *   offset line; offset0 as a thin dashed line; water above the ground (at sea level, and lakes labelled with
 *   their level); sea level 63 as a dashed line; river channels and gorges as stripes with a marker on the top
 *   edge; under the axis a strip with jag. Hovering the plot reads the nearest point.
 * - The profile is requested (model.ts createSectionRequests) when the preview driver settles while the tab is
 *   on screen, when the tab comes on screen while it is settled and when a new line is set, so it always runs on
 *   the draft the map shows. It is stale (dimmed, with its status) from the next session change, or during a
 *   gesture, until a new result arrives; a cancelled request stays stale silently, any other failure also
 *   shows a notice.
 */
import './section.css';
import { SEA_LEVEL } from '../../core/constants';
import type { WorldSession } from '../../engine/session';
import type { WorkerPool } from '../../engine/workerPool';
import type { CrossSectionProfile, Segment } from '../../metrics/crossSection';
import { el } from '../common/dom';
import type { Notices } from '../common/notice';
import type { PreviewDriver } from '../map/previewDriver';
import { curvePath, niceTicks, toPx, type Plot } from '../splineEditor/model';
import {
  areaPath, createSectionRequests, flagRuns, nearestPoint, runSpan, sectionRange, sectionReadout, sectionStatus, sectionSummary, sectionView,
  segmentText, waterRuns, type Run,
} from './model';

export interface SectionDeps {
  readonly session: WorldSession;
  readonly notices: Notices;
  /** The pool's statistics jobs (spec §5.4). */
  readonly pool: Pick<WorkerPool, 'stats'>;
  /** The preview driver: the profile is requested when it settles. */
  readonly driver: Pick<PreviewDriver, 'onSettled' | 'status'>;
  /** Whether the drawer shows this tab. */
  visible(): boolean;
  /** Arms the map's cut-line tool (New line). */
  arm(): void;
  /** Removes the line from the map and from this tab (Clear). */
  clear(): void;
  /** Closes the drawer (Close). */
  close(): void;
}

export interface CrossSection {
  readonly element: HTMLElement;
  /** Profiles `line` (null: none); requests it at once if the tab is on screen and the driver is settled. */
  setLine(line: Segment | null): void;
  readonly line: Segment | null;
  /** The tab came on screen: renders and requests the profile if the driver is settled and it is not current. */
  shown(): void;
  /** Stops following the session and the driver (the DOM stays). */
  dispose(): void;
}

const SVG_NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';

function svg<K extends keyof SVGElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Readonly<Record<string, string | number>> = {}, text = ''): SVGElementTagNameMap[K] {
  const e = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, tag);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs)) e.setAttribute(k, String(v));
  if (text !== '') e.textContent = text;
  return e;
}

/** Margins in CSS px: y tick labels on the left; under the main plot its x tick labels, a gap and the jag strip. */
const MARGIN = { left: 46, right: 12, top: 12 } as const;
const X_TICKS_PX = 14;
const GAP_PX = 6;
const JAG_PX = 34;
const BOTTOM_PX = 4;
const MARKER_PX = 6;
const CLIP_ID = 'cs-plot-clip';
const HINT = 'hover the plot to read a point';

const tickText = (v: number): string => String(v).replace('-', '−');

export function createCrossSection(host: HTMLElement, deps: SectionDeps): CrossSection {
  const { session } = deps;
  const element = el('div', 'cs');
  const button = (text: string, tip: string, run: () => void): HTMLButtonElement => {
    const b = el('button', '', text);
    b.type = 'button';
    b.title = tip;
    b.addEventListener('click', run);
    return b;
  };

  const head = el('div', 'cs-head');
  const lineText = el('span', 'cs-line');
  const status = el('span', 'cs-status');
  const actions = el('div', 'cs-actions');
  const newBtn = button('New line', 'Draw a new line on the map: click its start A, then its end B (Escape cancels)', () => deps.arm());
  const clearBtn = button('Clear', 'Remove the line from the map and this tab', () => deps.clear());
  actions.append(newBtn, clearBtn, button('Close', 'Close the drawer (Escape)', () => deps.close()));
  head.append(el('strong', 'cs-title', 'Cross-section'), lineText, status, actions);
  const summary = el('div', 'cs-summary');
  const plotHost = el('div', 'cs-plotwrap');
  const root = svg('svg', { class: 'cs-plot', role: 'img', 'aria-label': 'Cross-section profile' });
  plotHost.append(root);
  const legend = el('div', 'cs-legend');
  for (const [cls, label] of [
    ['cs-key-offset', 'offset'], ['cs-key-band', 'offset ± σ'], ['cs-key-offset0', 'offset0'], ['cs-key-sea', 'water at sea level'],
    ['cs-key-lake', 'lake'], ['cs-key-sealine', `sea level ${SEA_LEVEL}`], ['cs-key-river', 'river channel'], ['cs-key-gorge', 'gorge'], ['cs-key-jag', 'jag'],
  ] as const) {
    const item = el('span', 'cs-key');
    item.append(el('span', `cs-swatch ${cls}`), el('span', '', label));
    legend.append(item);
  }
  const readout = el('div', 'cs-readout', HINT);
  element.append(head, summary, plotHost, legend, readout);
  host.replaceChildren(element);

  let w = 0;
  let h = 0;
  /** The main plot of the last draw, for the hover readout. */
  let plot: Plot | null = null;
  let cursor: SVGLineElement | null = null;

  const requests = createSectionRequests({
    session, pool: deps.pool,
    visible: () => deps.visible(),
    changed: () => render(),
    failed: (m) => deps.notices.show(`cross-section failed: ${m}`, { kind: 'warn' }),
  });

  function draw(p: CrossSectionProfile | null, stale: boolean): void {
    plot = null;
    cursor = null;
    if (p === null || w <= 0 || h <= 0) {
      root.replaceChildren();
      return;
    }
    const range = sectionRange(p);
    const height = Math.max(20, h - MARGIN.top - X_TICKS_PX - GAP_PX - JAG_PX - BOTTOM_PX);
    const width = Math.max(20, w - MARGIN.left - MARGIN.right);
    const main: Plot = { left: MARGIN.left, top: MARGIN.top, width, height, xMin: 0, xMax: p.length, yMin: range.lo, yMax: range.hi };
    const jagTop = MARGIN.top + height + X_TICKS_PX + GAP_PX;
    const jagPlot: Plot = { left: MARGIN.left, top: jagTop, width, height: JAG_PX, xMin: 0, xMax: p.length, yMin: 0, yMax: range.jagMax };
    plot = main;
    root.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 ${w} ${h}`);
    root.setAttribute('width', String(w));
    root.setAttribute('height', String(h));
    const right = main.left + width;
    const bottom = main.top + height;
    const xAt = (d: number): number => toPx(main, d, 0).px;
    const yAt = (y: number): number => toPx(main, 0, y).py;
    const all: Run = { from: 0, to: p.offset.length - 1 };
    const out: SVGElement[] = [];

    const defs = svg('defs');
    const clip = svg('clipPath', { id: CLIP_ID });
    clip.append(svg('rect', { x: main.left, y: main.top, width, height }));
    defs.append(clip);
    out.push(defs, svg('rect', { class: 'cs-frame', x: main.left, y: main.top, width, height }), svg('rect', { class: 'cs-frame cs-jag-frame', x: main.left, y: jagTop, width, height: JAG_PX }));

    // Grid and ticks: distance from A on x (through both strips), blocks on y.
    for (const t of niceTicks(0, p.length, Math.max(2, Math.floor(width / 70)))) {
      out.push(svg('line', { class: 'cs-grid', x1: xAt(t), y1: main.top, x2: xAt(t), y2: jagTop + JAG_PX }));
      out.push(svg('text', { class: 'cs-tick', x: xAt(t), y: bottom + 11, 'text-anchor': 'middle' }, tickText(t)));
    }
    for (const t of niceTicks(range.lo, range.hi, Math.max(3, Math.floor(height / 24)))) {
      out.push(svg('line', { class: 'cs-grid', x1: main.left, y1: yAt(t), x2: right, y2: yAt(t) }));
      out.push(svg('text', { class: 'cs-tick', x: main.left - 4, y: yAt(t) + 3, 'text-anchor': 'end' }, tickText(t)));
    }
    out.push(svg('text', { class: 'cs-axis-label', x: 0, y: 0, transform: `translate(11 ${main.top + height / 2}) rotate(-90)`, 'text-anchor': 'middle' }, 'blocks'));

    // The profile, clipped to the main plot: ground, water, the σ band, offset and offset0, sea level, rivers and gorges.
    const g = svg('g', { 'clip-path': `url(#${CLIP_ID})` });
    g.append(svg('path', { class: 'cs-ground', d: areaPath(main, p, all, (i) => p.offset[i]!, () => range.lo, false) }));
    for (const r of waterRuns(p)) {
      const water = svg('path', { class: `cs-water cs-water-${r.kind}`, d: areaPath(main, p, r, () => r.level, (i) => p.offset[i]!, true) });
      water.append(svg('title', {}, r.kind === 'lake' ? `lake at ${r.level}` : `water at sea level ${r.level}`));
      g.append(water);
    }
    g.append(svg('path', { class: 'cs-band', d: areaPath(main, p, all, (i) => p.offset[i]! + p.sigma[i]!, (i) => p.offset[i]! - p.sigma[i]!, false) }));
    g.append(svg('path', { class: 'cs-offset', d: curvePath(main, p.distance, p.offset) }));
    g.append(svg('path', { class: 'cs-offset0', d: curvePath(main, p.distance, p.offset0) }));
    g.append(svg('line', { class: 'cs-sealine', x1: main.left, y1: yAt(SEA_LEVEL), x2: right, y2: yAt(SEA_LEVEL) }));
    const stripes = (runs: readonly Run[], cls: string, name: string) => {
      for (const r of runs) {
        const s = runSpan(main, p, r);
        const mid = (s.x0 + s.x1) / 2;
        const stripe = svg('g', { class: cls });
        stripe.append(svg('rect', { class: 'cs-stripe', x: s.x0, y: main.top, width: Math.max(1, s.x1 - s.x0), height }));
        stripe.append(svg('path', { class: 'cs-marker', d: `M${mid - MARKER_PX / 2},${main.top}L${mid + MARKER_PX / 2},${main.top}L${mid},${main.top + MARKER_PX}Z` }));
        stripe.append(svg('title', {}, `${name}: ${p.distance[r.from]!.toFixed(0)}-${p.distance[r.to]!.toFixed(0)} blocks from A`));
        g.append(stripe);
      }
    };
    stripes(flagRuns(p.riverWet), 'cs-river', 'river channel');
    stripes(flagRuns(p.gorge), 'cs-gorge', 'gorge');
    out.push(g);
    for (const r of waterRuns(p)) {
      if (r.kind !== 'lake') continue;
      const s = runSpan(main, p, r);
      out.push(svg('text', { class: 'cs-lake-label', x: (s.x0 + s.x1) / 2, y: yAt(r.level) - 3, 'text-anchor': 'middle' }, `lake ${r.level}`));
    }
    out.push(svg('text', { class: 'cs-sea-label', x: main.left + 4, y: yAt(SEA_LEVEL) - 3 }, `sea ${SEA_LEVEL}`));
    out.push(svg('text', { class: 'cs-end-label', x: main.left + 3, y: main.top - 2 }, 'A'));
    out.push(svg('text', { class: 'cs-end-label', x: right - 3, y: main.top - 2, 'text-anchor': 'end' }, 'B'));

    // The jag strip.
    out.push(svg('path', { class: 'cs-jag', d: areaPath(jagPlot, p, all, (i) => p.jag[i]!, () => 0, false) }));
    out.push(svg('text', { class: 'cs-tick', x: main.left - 4, y: jagTop + 8, 'text-anchor': 'end' }, String(range.jagMax)));
    out.push(svg('text', { class: 'cs-tick', x: main.left - 4, y: jagTop + JAG_PX, 'text-anchor': 'end' }, '0'));
    out.push(svg('text', { class: 'cs-axis-label', x: main.left + 4, y: jagTop + 10 }, 'jag'));

    if (stale) out.push(svg('text', { class: 'cs-stale-label', x: right - 4, y: main.top + 12, 'text-anchor': 'end' }, 'profile stale'));
    cursor = svg('line', { class: 'cs-cursor', x1: 0, y1: main.top, x2: 0, y2: jagTop + JAG_PX, visibility: 'hidden' });
    out.push(cursor);
    root.replaceChildren(...out);
  }

  /** The profile drawn last, so that a session change that leaves it as it was does not redraw it. */
  let drawn: { readonly profile: CrossSectionProfile | null; readonly stale: boolean; readonly w: number; readonly h: number } | null = null;

  function render(): void {
    const line = requests.line;
    const shown = requests.shown;
    const view = sectionView(shown?.epoch ?? null, session.state.epoch, session.inGesture);
    element.dataset['state'] = view;
    element.setAttribute('aria-busy', String(requests.pending !== null));
    lineText.textContent = line === null ? '' : segmentText(line);
    status.textContent = sectionStatus(view, requests.pending !== null, line !== null);
    clearBtn.disabled = line === null;
    const profile = shown?.profile ?? null;
    summary.textContent = profile === null ? '' : sectionSummary(profile);
    plotHost.classList.toggle('cs-stale', view === 'stale');
    if (!deps.visible()) return;
    const stale = view === 'stale';
    if (drawn !== null && drawn.profile === profile && drawn.stale === stale && drawn.w === w && drawn.h === h) return;
    drawn = { profile, stale, w, h };
    draw(profile, stale);
    readout.textContent = HINT;
    delete readout.dataset['point'];
  }

  root.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    const p = requests.shown?.profile;
    if (plot === null || cursor === null || p === undefined) return;
    const r = root.getBoundingClientRect();
    const px = e.clientX - r.left;
    if (px < plot.left - 2 || px > plot.left + plot.width + 2) {
      cursor.setAttribute('visibility', 'hidden');
      readout.textContent = HINT;
      return;
    }
    const i = nearestPoint(plot, px);
    const x = toPx(plot, p.distance[i]!, 0).px;
    cursor.setAttribute('x1', String(x));
    cursor.setAttribute('x2', String(x));
    cursor.setAttribute('visibility', 'visible');
    readout.textContent = sectionReadout(p, i);
    readout.dataset['point'] = String(i);
  });
  root.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
    cursor?.setAttribute('visibility', 'hidden');
    readout.textContent = HINT;
    delete readout.dataset['point'];
  });

  new ResizeObserver(() => {
    const r = plotHost.getBoundingClientRect();
    w = Math.floor(r.width);
    h = Math.floor(r.height);
    render();
  }).observe(plotHost);

  const offSession = session.subscribe(() => render());
  // The driver's status still reads unsettled while it runs its onSettled listeners.
  const offSettled = deps.driver.onSettled(() => requests.request(true));
  render();

  return {
    element,
    setLine(line) {
      requests.setLine(line);
      requests.request(deps.driver.status.settled);
    },
    get line() { return requests.line; },
    shown() {
      render();
      requests.request(deps.driver.status.settled);
    },
    dispose() {
      offSession();
      offSettled();
    },
  };
}

/* The Cross-section tab (SP2b spec §4.5): header, summary, the profile plot, its legend and the hover readout. */
.cs { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; height: 100%; min-height: 0; }

.cs-status { font-size: 12px; color: #8a95a8; }
.cs[data-state="stale"] .cs-status { color: #f0b34a; }

.cs-summary:empty { display: none; }
.cs-plotwrap { position: relative; min-width: 0; min-height: 120px; overflow: hidden; }
.cs-plot { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: block; user-select: none; touch-action: none; }
.cs-plotwrap.cs-stale .cs-plot { opacity: 0.4; }
.cs-frame { fill: #15171b; stroke: #34406a; stroke-width: 0.5; }
.cs-grid { stroke: #252b38; stroke-width: 1; }
.cs-tick, .cs-axis-label, .cs-sea-label, .cs-lake-label, .cs-end-label, .cs-stale-label { font: 10px ui-monospace, monospace; fill: #8a95a8; }
.cs-axis-label { fill: #c0c8d8; }
.cs-end-label { font-weight: 700; fill: #e8ecf2; }
.cs-ground { fill: #3b3327; }

.cs-offset { fill: none; stroke: #e8c88f; stroke-width: 1.6; }

.cs-water-sea { fill: #2f6db5; fill-opacity: 0.7; }
.cs-water-lake { fill: #3fb3d6; fill-opacity: 0.75; }
.cs-sealine { stroke: #5f9bd6; stroke-dasharray: 4 3; }

.cs-lake-label { fill: #7fd3ec; }
.cs-river .cs-stripe { fill: #6fa8e8; fill-opacity: 0.22; }
.cs-river .cs-marker { fill: #6fa8e8; }
.cs-gorge .cs-stripe { fill: #e0904a; fill-opacity: 0.25; }
.cs-gorge .cs-marker { fill: #e0904a; }
.cs-jag { fill: #b48ead; fill-opacity: 0.7; }
.cs-stale-label { fill: #f0b34a; }
.cs-cursor { stroke: #ffffff; stroke-opacity: 0.6; stroke-width: 1; pointer-events: none; }
.cs-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px 12px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 11px; color: #9aa; }
.cs-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.cs-swatch { display: inline-block; width: 14px; height: 8px; border-radius: 1px; }
.cs-key-offset { height: 0; border-top: 2px solid #e8c88f; }
.cs-key-band { background: rgba(224, 179, 106, 0.4); }
.cs-key-offset0 { height: 0; border-top: 1px dashed #c9d1dd; }
.cs-key-sea { background: #2f6db5; }
.cs-key-lake { background: #3fb3d6; }
.cs-key-sealine { height: 0; border-top: 1px dashed #5f9bd6; }
.cs-key-river { background: rgba(111, 168, 232, 0.5); }
.cs-key-gorge { background: rgba(224, 144, 74, 0.55); }
.cs-key-jag { background: #b48ead; }
.cs-readout { padding: 2px 10px 4px; font: 11px ui-monospace, monospace; color: #b8c2d0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

- [ ] **Step 6: Browser check (headless Chrome over CDP; scratch script, not committed)**

The script starts its own `vite preview` on port 5311 and its own Chrome (CDP port 9361, profile `<out dir>/prof`, removed at the end), drives `?map` at seed 42 with the view on the line of the unit tests (4 blocks/px; the view centre is set so that whole canvas pixels land on A = (5120, 3072) and B = (6656, 3072)), and stops both. Its expected texts are the Node values of `crossSectionInto` + `summarizeCrossSection` + `sectionSummary`/`sectionReadout` for the default params and for `rivers.gorgeDepth` 40 (computed with a temporary test file, deleted).

`SCR/t23/check.mjs`:

```js
// Task 23 browser check (scratch, not committed): the cut-line tool and the Cross-section tab in ?map on `vite
// preview` and headless Chrome over CDP. Run `npm run build` in the worktree first.
// Usage: node check.mjs <worktree> <out dir> <shot path>
// Starts its own vite preview (port 5311) and Chrome (CDP port 9361, profile under <out dir>), stops both at the end.
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const [REPO, OUT, SHOT] = process.argv.slice(2);
const PORT = 5311;
const CDP = 9361;
const PROFILE = `${OUT}/prof`;
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

/** The line of the unit tests: seed 42, from the sea west of (5888, 3072) over rivers, gorges and a lake at 153. */
const A = [5120, 3072];
const B = [6656, 3072];
const BPP = 4;
/** Node, one thread (crossSectionInto + summarizeCrossSection + the tab's texts), default params and gorgeDepth 40. */
const LINE_TEXT = 'A (5120, 3072) → B (6656, 3072) · 1 536 blocks';
const SUMMARY = 'offset 22.1 to 209.1 blocks · water on 48.0 % of the line · 2 river channels · 2 gorges · 1 lake at 153';
const BASE = {
  318: '955.9 blocks from A · x 6075.9 z 3072.0 · offset0 143.20 · offset 90.65 ± 0.50 · jag 0.00 · gorge',
  350: '1052.1 blocks from A · x 6172.1 z 3072.0 · offset0 206.93 · offset 198.71 ± 0.50 · jag 0.00 · gorge',
  480: '1442.8 blocks from A · x 6562.8 z 3072.0 · offset0 157.31 · offset 149.05 ± 3.25 · jag 0.00 · lake at 153, 3.95 deep',
  0: '0.0 blocks from A · x 5120.0 z 3072.0 · offset0 22.61 · offset 22.61 ± 3.00 · jag 0.00 · water at sea level 63, 40.39 deep',
};
const DEEP = {
  318: '955.9 blocks from A · x 6075.9 z 3072.0 · offset0 143.20 · offset 78.26 ± 0.50 · jag 0.00 · gorge',
  350: '1052.1 blocks from A · x 6172.1 z 3072.0 · offset0 206.93 · offset 179.51 ± 0.50 · jag 0.00 · gorge',
};
const hashOf = (x, z) => Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ v: 1, seed: '42', profile: 'default', patch: {}, view: { x, z, bpp: BPP, layer: 'biome' } })).toString('base64url');

const children = [];
const failures = [];
const check = (ok, what) => { console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${what}`); if (!ok) failures.push(what); };

function start(cmd, args, opts) {
  const c = spawn(cmd, args, opts);
  children.push(c);
  return c;
}

async function main() {
  mkdirSync(PROFILE, { recursive: true });
  const vite = start('node', ['node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js', 'preview', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', String(PORT), '--strictPort'], { cwd: REPO, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let text = '';
    vite.stdout.on('data', (d) => { text += d; if (text.includes(`http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/`)) resolve(); });
    vite.on('exit', (code) => reject(new Error(`vite preview exited ${code}: ${text}`)));
  });
  console.log(`vite preview on ${PORT} (pid ${vite.pid})`);
  const chrome = start('/usr/bin/google-chrome', [
    '--headless=new', `--user-data-dir=${PROFILE}`, `--remote-debugging-port=${CDP}`, '--no-first-run', '--no-default-browser-check',
    '--window-size=1400,1000', 'about:blank',
  ], { stdio: 'ignore' });
  let version = null;
  let target = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < 100 && target === null; i++) {
    try {
      version = await (await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${CDP}/json/version`)).json();
      target = (await (await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${CDP}/json/list`)).json()).find((t) => t.type === 'page') ?? null;
    } catch { /* not up yet */ }
    if (target === null) await sleep(100);
  }
  if (target === null) throw new Error('Chrome did not start');
  console.log(`${version.Browser} on CDP ${CDP} (pid ${chrome.pid})`);

  const ws = new WebSocket(target.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
  await new Promise((r) => ws.addEventListener('open', r, { once: true }));
  let id = 0;
  const pending = new Map();
  const logs = [];
  ws.addEventListener('message', (ev) => {
    const m = JSON.parse(ev.data);
    if (m.id && pending.has(m.id)) { pending.get(m.id)(m); pending.delete(m.id); }
    if (m.method === 'Runtime.consoleAPICalled') logs.push(`console.${m.params.type}: ${m.params.args.map((a) => a.value ?? a.description).join(' ')}`);
    if (m.method === 'Runtime.exceptionThrown') logs.push(`exception: ${m.params.exceptionDetails.exception?.description ?? m.params.exceptionDetails.text}`);
    if (m.method === 'Log.entryAdded' && m.params.entry.level === 'error') logs.push(`log.error: ${m.params.entry.text} ${m.params.entry.url ?? ''}`);
  });
  const send = (method, params = {}) => new Promise((r) => { const i = ++id; pending.set(i, r); ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id: i, method, params })); });
  const evaluate = async (expr) => {
    const r = await send('Runtime.evaluate', { expression: expr, awaitPromise: true, returnByValue: true });
    if (r.result.exceptionDetails) throw new Error(r.result.exceptionDetails.exception?.description ?? 'eval failed');
    return r.result.result.value;
  };
  const shot = async (path) => {
    const r = await send('Page.captureScreenshot', { format: 'png' });
    writeFileSync(path, Buffer.from(r.result.data, 'base64'));
    console.log(`screenshot ${path}`);
  };
  const key = async (k, code, vk, modifiers) => {
    await send('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', { type: 'keyDown', key: k, code, windowsVirtualKeyCode: vk, modifiers });
    await send('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', { type: 'keyUp', key: k, code, windowsVirtualKeyCode: vk, modifiers });
  };
  const move = (x, y) => send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mouseMoved', x, y });
  const click = async (x, y) => {
    await move(x, y);
    await send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mousePressed', x, y, button: 'left', buttons: 1, clickCount: 1 });
    await send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mouseReleased', x, y, button: 'left', buttons: 0, clickCount: 1 });
  };
  await send('Runtime.enable');
  await send('Page.enable');
  await send('Log.enable');
  await send('Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride', { width: 1400, height: 1000, deviceScaleFactor: 1, mobile: false });
  await send('Page.navigate', { url: `http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/?map#${hashOf(5888, 3072)}` });

  // In-page helpers: the tab's state, the drawer, the toolbar button, frame-by-frame waits and the settled preview.
  const HELPERS = `globalThis.__t23 = {
    state: () => { const c = document.querySelector('.cs'); return { state: c.dataset.state, busy: c.getAttribute('aria-busy'), status: c.querySelector('.cs-status').textContent }; },
    line: () => document.querySelector('.cs-line').textContent,
    summary: () => document.querySelector('.cs-summary').textContent,
    readout: () => { const r = document.querySelector('.cs-readout'); return { text: r.textContent, point: r.dataset.point ?? null }; },
    drawer: () => { const d = document.querySelector('.map-drawer'); return { open: !d.hidden, tab: document.querySelector('.map-drawer-tabs [aria-selected="true"]').id }; },
    cut: () => { const b = document.querySelector('.map-cut'); return { label: b.textContent, pressed: b.getAttribute('aria-pressed'), crosshair: document.querySelector('.map-canvas').classList.contains('map-canvas-cut') }; },
    counts: () => Object.fromEntries(['.cs-water-sea', '.cs-water-lake', '.cs-river', '.cs-gorge', '.cs-ground', '.cs-band', '.cs-offset', '.cs-offset0', '.cs-sealine', '.cs-jag', '.cs-lake-label'].map((s) => [s, document.querySelectorAll('.cs-plot ' + s).length])),
    lakeLabel: () => document.querySelector('.cs-lake-label')?.textContent ?? null,
    frame: () => { const r = document.querySelector('.cs-plot .cs-frame').getBoundingClientRect(); return { left: r.left, top: r.top, width: r.width, height: r.height }; },
    notices: () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.map-notices .notice')].map((n) => n.textContent),
    world: () => document.querySelector('#map-tabpanel-world .map-readout').textContent,
    frames: (pred, ms) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const t0 = performance.now();
      const step = () => { if (pred()) resolve(performance.now() - t0); else if (performance.now() - t0 > ms) reject(new Error('timeout')); else requestAnimationFrame(step); };
      step();
    }),
    settled: () => { const s = document.querySelector('.map-status').textContent; return s.includes('ms') && !s.includes('pending'); },
    trail: [],
    // Every change of the tab's state, busy flag and status (a MutationObserver: a request can start and end within one frame).
    watch: () => {
      const t = globalThis.__t23; t.trail = []; let last = '';
      const rec = () => { const s = t.state(); const k = s.state + '/' + s.busy + '/' + s.status; if (k !== last) { last = k; t.trail.push(k); } };
      rec();
      t.mo = new MutationObserver(rec);
      t.mo.observe(document.querySelector('.cs'), { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-state', 'aria-busy'], subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true });
    },
    unwatch: () => { globalThis.__t23.mo.disconnect(); return globalThis.__t23.trail; },
  }; true`;
  for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
    if (await evaluate(`document.querySelector('.cs') !== null && document.querySelector('.map-status') !== null && document.querySelector('.map-cut') !== null`)) break;
    await sleep(100);
  }
  await evaluate(HELPERS);
  const st = () => evaluate('__t23.state()');
  const waitFresh = (ms = 20000) => evaluate(`__t23.frames(() => __t23.state().state === 'fresh' && __t23.state().busy === 'false', ${ms})`);

  // 1. Load at seed 42 with the view on the line (4 blocks/px). The view centre is chosen so that whole canvas pixels
  //    land on the line's ends: A 192 px left of the centre pixel, B 192 px right of it.
  await evaluate(`__t23.frames(__t23.settled, 20000)`);
  const c = await evaluate(`(() => { const cv = document.querySelector('.map-canvas'); const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect(); return { w: cv.width, h: cv.height, left: r.left, top: r.top, cssW: r.width, cssH: r.height }; })()`);
  const ox = Math.round(c.w / 2) - 192;
  const oy = Math.round(c.h / 2);
  const vx = A[0] - (ox - c.w / 2) * BPP;
  const vz = A[1] - (oy - c.h / 2) * BPP;
  if (vx !== 5888 || vz !== 3072) {
    await evaluate(`location.hash = ${JSON.stringify(hashOf(vx, vz))}; true`);
    await sleep(300);
    await evaluate(`__t23.frames(__t23.settled, 20000)`);
  }
  await sleep(300);
  const world = await evaluate('__t23.world()');
  const s1 = await st();
  const d1 = await evaluate('__t23.drawer()');
  console.log(`1. canvas ${c.w}×${c.h} (css ${c.cssW}×${c.cssH} at ${c.left},${c.top}); view centre ${vx}, ${vz}; drawer ${JSON.stringify(d1)}; tab ${JSON.stringify(s1)}`);
  check(world.includes(`view x ${vx} z ${vz}  4.00 blocks/px`) && !d1.open && s1.state === 'none' && s1.busy === 'false', 'page at the line\'s view, drawer closed, no profile requested');
  check(s1.status === 'no line: press Cut line in the toolbar, then click A and B on the map', 'the tab\'s status asks for a line');

  // 2. Arm the tool from the toolbar.
  await evaluate(`document.querySelector('.map-cut').click(); true`);
  const cut2 = await evaluate('__t23.cut()');
  console.log(`2. toolbar Cut line: ${JSON.stringify(cut2)}`);
  check(cut2.label === 'Cut line: click A' && cut2.pressed === 'true' && cut2.crosshair, 'Cut line arms the tool (pressed, crosshair)');

  // 3. A: one click; the rubber band follows the pointer.
  const ax = c.left + ox;
  const bx = c.left + ox + 384;
  const yy = c.top + oy;
  await click(ax, yy);
  const cut3 = await evaluate('__t23.cut()');
  await move(ax + 250, yy - 60);
  await sleep(150);
  await shot(`${OUT}/rubber-band.png`);
  console.log(`3. click A at ${ax},${yy}: ${JSON.stringify(cut3)}`);
  check(cut3.label === 'Cut line: click B' && cut3.pressed === 'true', 'the first click sets A and waits for B');

  // 4. B: the second click ends the tool, opens the drawer on the Cross-section tab and requests the profile.
  await evaluate(`__t23.watch(); true`);
  const t4 = Date.now();
  await click(bx, yy);
  const right = await evaluate(`({ cut: __t23.cut(), drawer: __t23.drawer(), state: __t23.state(), line: __t23.line() })`);
  const ms4 = await waitFresh();
  const trail4 = await evaluate('__t23.unwatch()');
  console.log(`4. click B at ${bx},${yy}: right after ${JSON.stringify(right)}; fresh ${ms4.toFixed(0)} ms later (${Date.now() - t4} ms wall); trail ${JSON.stringify(trail4)}`);
  check(right.cut.label === 'Cut line' && right.cut.pressed === 'false' && !right.cut.crosshair, 'the second click ends the tool');
  check(right.drawer.open && right.drawer.tab === 'map-drawer-tab-section', 'the drawer opens on the Cross-section tab');
  check(right.line === LINE_TEXT, `the tab shows the line ${LINE_TEXT}`);
  check(trail4.some((k) => k.startsWith('none/true/computing')) && trail4[trail4.length - 1] === 'fresh/false/', 'computing, then fresh');
  const sum4 = await evaluate('__t23.summary()');
  const counts4 = await evaluate('__t23.counts()');
  console.log(`   summary "${sum4}"`);
  console.log(`   plot ${JSON.stringify(counts4)}; lake label ${JSON.stringify(await evaluate('__t23.lakeLabel()'))}`);
  check(sum4 === SUMMARY, 'the summary equals the Node profile\'s');
  check(counts4['.cs-water-sea'] === 3 && counts4['.cs-water-lake'] === 1 && counts4['.cs-river'] === 2 && counts4['.cs-gorge'] === 2
    && ['.cs-ground', '.cs-band', '.cs-offset', '.cs-offset0', '.cs-sealine', '.cs-jag', '.cs-lake-label'].every((s) => counts4[s] === 1), 'the plot draws 3 sea runs, 1 lake, 2 river channels, 2 gorges, the band, both lines, sea level and jag');

  // 5. Hover readouts equal Node's texts at a gorge, a lake and a sea point.
  const f = await evaluate('__t23.frame()');
  const atPoint = (i) => f.left + (f.width * i) / 511;
  const read = async (i) => {
    await move(atPoint(i) + 30, f.top + f.height / 2);
    await move(atPoint(i), f.top + f.height / 2);
    await sleep(50);
    return evaluate('__t23.readout()');
  };
  const r5 = {};
  for (const i of [318, 350, 480, 0]) r5[i] = await read(i);
  for (const i of [318, 350, 480, 0]) console.log(`5. hover point ${i}: ${JSON.stringify(r5[i])}`);
  check([318, 350, 480, 0].every((i) => r5[i].text === BASE[i] && r5[i].point === String(i)), 'hover readouts equal the Node values (gorge, gorge, lake, sea)');

  // 6. An edit (rivers.gorgeDepth 12 → 40, typed in the Parameters tab): stale at once, then fresh with deeper gorges.
  await evaluate(`__t23.watch(); true`);
  const t6 = await evaluate(`(() => { const f = document.getElementById('pp-rivers.gorgeDepth'); f.value = '40'; f.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return __t23.state(); })()`);
  console.log(`6. gorgeDepth 40: right after the edit ${JSON.stringify(t6)}`);
  check(t6.state === 'stale' && t6.status.startsWith('stale'), 'the profile is stale right after the session change');
  await shot(`${OUT}/stale.png`);
  const ms6 = await waitFresh();
  const trail6 = await evaluate('__t23.unwatch()');
  console.log(`   fresh ${ms6.toFixed(0)} ms later; trail ${JSON.stringify(trail6)}`);
  check(trail6.some((k) => k.startsWith('stale/true/stale: computing')), 'stale while the new request runs');
  const r6 = { 318: await read(318), 350: await read(350) };
  console.log(`   hover 318 ${JSON.stringify(r6[318])}; 350 ${JSON.stringify(r6[350])}`);
  check(r6[318].text === DEEP[318] && r6[350].text === DEEP[350], 'the refreshed profile has the deeper gorges Node computes');
  await read(470);
  await shot(SHOT);

  // 7. Undo (Ctrl+Z): stale, then fresh with the default gorges again.
  await evaluate(`__t23.watch(); true`);
  await key('z', 'KeyZ', 90, 2);
  const ms7 = await evaluate(`(async () => { await __t23.frames(() => __t23.state().state === 'stale', 5000); return __t23.frames(() => __t23.state().state === 'fresh' && __t23.state().busy === 'false', 20000); })()`);
  const trail7 = await evaluate('__t23.unwatch()');
  const r7 = await read(318);
  console.log(`7. undo: trail ${JSON.stringify(trail7)}; fresh after ${ms7.toFixed(0)} ms; hover 318 ${JSON.stringify(r7)}`);
  check(r7.text === BASE[318], 'after undo the profile is the default one again');

  // 8. Escape cancels an armed tool (the drawer stays); the next Escape closes the drawer.
  await evaluate(`document.querySelector('.map-cut').click(); true`);
  await key('Escape', 'Escape', 27, 0);
  const e8 = await evaluate(`({ cut: __t23.cut(), drawer: __t23.drawer(), line: __t23.line() })`);
  await click(ax, yy - 100);
  const e8b = await evaluate(`({ cut: __t23.cut(), line: __t23.line() })`);
  console.log(`8. armed, Escape: ${JSON.stringify(e8)}; a map click after it: ${JSON.stringify(e8b)}`);
  check(e8.cut.label === 'Cut line' && e8.cut.pressed === 'false' && !e8.cut.crosshair && e8.drawer.open && e8.line === LINE_TEXT, 'Escape cancels the tool and keeps the line and the drawer');
  check(e8b.cut.label === 'Cut line' && e8b.line === LINE_TEXT, 'a click after the cancel pins the point; the line stays');
  await key('Escape', 'Escape', 27, 0);
  const d8 = await evaluate('__t23.drawer()');
  check(!d8.open, 'the next Escape closes the drawer');

  // 9. Drawer closed: redo (gorgeDepth 40) settles without a request; a click on the line opens its profile.
  await key('z', 'KeyZ', 90, 10);
  await evaluate(`__t23.frames(__t23.settled, 20000)`);
  await sleep(500);
  const s9 = await st();
  console.log(`9. drawer closed, redo, settled: ${JSON.stringify(s9)}`);
  check(s9.state === 'stale' && s9.busy === 'false', 'a hidden tab goes stale without a request');
  await click(ax + 192, yy + 2);
  const d9 = await evaluate('__t23.drawer()');
  const ms9 = await waitFresh();
  const r9 = await read(318);
  console.log(`   click on the line: drawer ${JSON.stringify(d9)}; fresh after ${ms9.toFixed(0)} ms; hover 318 ${JSON.stringify(r9)}`);
  check(d9.open && d9.tab === 'map-drawer-tab-section' && r9.text === DEEP[318], 'a click on the line opens the Cross-section tab, which requests the redone draft');

  // 10. The Spline tab without an open spline shows its hint; back on Cross-section nothing is requested again.
  await evaluate(`document.getElementById('map-drawer-tab-spline').click(); true`);
  const hint = await evaluate(`document.querySelector('.sd-title').textContent + ' | body hidden ' + document.querySelector('.sd-body').hidden`);
  await evaluate(`document.getElementById('map-drawer-tab-section').click(); true`);
  const s10 = await st();
  console.log(`10. Spline tab: "${hint}"; back on Cross-section: ${JSON.stringify(s10)}`);
  check(hint === 'No spline open: press Edit on a spline in the Parameters tab | body hidden true', 'the Spline tab shows its hint while no spline is open');
  check(s10.state === 'fresh' && s10.busy === 'false', 'switching tabs back requests nothing new (already fresh)');

  // 11. Clear removes the line; the status asks for a line again.
  await evaluate(`[...document.querySelectorAll('.cs-actions button')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Clear').click(); true`);
  const s11 = await st();
  const l11 = await evaluate('__t23.line()');
  console.log(`11. Clear: ${JSON.stringify(s11)}; line "${l11}"`);
  check(s11.state === 'none' && l11 === '' && s11.status.startsWith('no line'), 'Clear removes the line and the profile');

  // 12. A spline's Edit opens the drawer on the Spline tab with the leaf, whose statistics arrive as before (Task 18).
  await evaluate(`document.querySelector('.pp-control[data-path="shape.offset"] .pp-edit').click(); true`);
  const d12 = await evaluate('__t23.drawer()');
  const ms12 = await evaluate(`__t23.frames(() => document.querySelector('.sd-stats').dataset.state === 'fresh', 20000)`);
  const sd12 = await evaluate(`({ title: document.querySelector('.sd-title').textContent, body: !document.querySelector('.sd-body').hidden, stats: document.querySelector('.sd-stats').textContent })`);
  console.log(`12. Edit shape.offset: drawer ${JSON.stringify(d12)}; statistics fresh after ${ms12.toFixed(0)} ms; ${JSON.stringify(sd12)}`);
  check(d12.open && d12.tab === 'map-drawer-tab-spline' && sd12.body && sd12.title === 'Offset (blocks)', 'Edit opens the Spline tab on the leaf, with its statistics');

  const errors = logs.filter((l) => !l.includes('favicon.ico'));
  console.log('--- page logs ---');
  for (const l of logs) console.log(l);
  check(errors.length === 0, 'no console errors or exceptions (favicon.ico 404 aside)');
  await send('Browser.close').catch(() => {});
  ws.close();
}

try {
  await main();
} catch (e) {
  failures.push(String(e));
  console.log(`ERROR ${e?.stack ?? e}`);
} finally {
  // Browser.close may already have ended Chrome; stop whatever this script started that still runs.
  const ended = (c) => c.exitCode !== null || c.signalCode !== null;
  for (const c of children) if (!ended(c)) c.kill('SIGTERM');
  for (let i = 0; i < 50 && children.some((c) => !ended(c)); i++) await sleep(100);
  for (const c of children) if (!ended(c)) c.kill('SIGKILL');
  rmSync(PROFILE, { recursive: true, force: true });
  console.log(`stopped ${children.length} child processes; ${failures.length === 0 ? 'ALL PASS' : `${failures.length} FAILED`}`);
  process.exitCode = failures.length === 0 ? 0 : 1;
}

Rebuilding the commit from this write-up's code blocks on the parent (the five `diff` blocks with `git apply`, plus the seven new files) gives the commit's tree, `7df9d1c9`.

Measured:
- Node, one thread, `samplePoint` without steep at 512 points (seeds 42, 7 and 1): 2.6-3.4 ms for lines of 100-1536 blocks once the context is warm, and 12.5 ms for the first line of a fresh context. Lines across the whole window took 29-40 ms: their 512 points fall in different lake cells, whose memo is cold. The worst single point took 2.5 ms. Polling `stop` every 256 points (spec §2.2's stats rule) therefore stops a job within about 20 ms.
- Chrome 153, D16, pool 6, three check runs (3, 4, 5): after the click on B, the profile is fresh 42 / 86 / 136 ms later. After the gorgeDepth edit, it is stale in the same task and fresh 274 / 275 / 265 ms later; that time also covers the preview cycle that has to settle first. After undo it is fresh in 7 / 27 / 7 ms, because the undone world's tiles are cached. Reopened by a click on the line, it is fresh after 191 ms in each run. The page's summary and the hover readouts at points 0, 318, 350 and 480 equal the Node texts, before and after the edit.

- Ruling: The sum's layout is 8 field blocks of 512 points: offset0, offset, sigma, jag, riverWet (1/0), gorge (1/0), lakeLevel, surfaceWaterLevel. −∞ is kept: there is no lake level outside a basin and no water on dry land. A range `[from, to)` writes only its own points, so disjoint ranges into zeroed arrays add up to the whole line, as the other kinds' sums do, even though the pool runs this kind as one job. Sea level is not a field; the UI draws the constant `SEA_LEVEL` (63). Cost if wrong: a reordering of `crossSectionInto` and `summarizeCrossSection`.
- Ruling: The points are A to B inclusive, point i at A + (B − A)·i/511, each coordinate clamped to the segment's bounding box. Without the clamp the formula can round onto 2^19. With A = (−0.1, 0) and B = (524287.99999999994, 0), point 511 is exactly 524288, outside the window. The test pins this case. Without it, a mutation run did not notice the clamp's removal; with it, the mutation is caught. Cost if wrong: two `Math.min`/`Math.max` per coordinate.
- Ruling: Shape check versus fit check. `parseToWorker` checks only that `ax`, `az`, `bx` and `bz` are numbers (BAD_MESSAGE otherwise). The handler's `segmentProblem` replies BAD_ARGS, as this task asks, when an end lies outside `[−2^19, 2^19)`; NaN and ±∞ count as outside. It also replies BAD_ARGS when A = B (−0 equals 0). The texts are pinned: `A (524288, 0) is outside the world window [-524288, 524288)` and `A and B are the same point (12, -3)`. The point jobs of Task 13 reject a point outside the window as BAD_MESSAGE; the cross-section's fit check is the handler's, as for the other stats kinds. Cost if wrong: four lines move from the handler to `statsOk`.
- Ruling: `STATS_KINDS` is now exported as `Readonly<Record<StatsKind, 'split' | 'single'>>`, frozen, with crossSection `'single'`. The pool reads it, which is allowed because engine may value-import `workers/protocol.ts`, and sends one job over `[0, n)`. This follows the Task 14 note: a new kind cannot be added without stating how it runs. The page always asks for `n = CROSS_SECTION_POINTS` and `args.len = crossSectionLength()` (4096). The handler checks `to ≤ 512` and the length. `sumFor` now takes the stream length rather than a `Points` object. Cost if wrong: one line in the pool.
- Ruling: The metric samples with `samplePoint(ctx, x, z, false, …)`. Steep is not drawn, and the column fields match `columnPoint`'s, which the test checks against a direct loop. `crossSection.ts` joins `DET_FILES`, test-driven by a bad fixture with `Date.now` and `Math.hypot`. The segment length uses `Math.sqrt`, because `Math.hypot` is not on the allowlist.
- Ruling: The cut-line tool has three states: off, waiting for A, waiting for B.
  - The toolbar's Cut line button arms it and, while armed, cancels it; the tab's New line button arms it too.
  - Clicks are rounded to whole blocks (`Math.round`, never −0). While the tool is armed a click never pins the point.
  - A point outside the half-open window, or a B in A's block, is refused with a warn notice for 4 s, and the tool keeps waiting.
  - While B is being placed, the map draws a dashed line from A to the pointer and the cursor is a crosshair.
  - Escape cancels an armed tool first and leaves the line and the drawer as they are; otherwise Escape closes the drawer, as before.
  - The finished line stays on the map until Clear or a new line replaces it.

  Cost if wrong: small changes to `cutClick` and the page.
- Ruling: Reopening. Once the drawer is closed, nothing else leads back to the profile. A click within 6 screen px of the line (tool off) therefore opens the Cross-section tab instead of pinning the point (`segmentDistance`, unit-tested). Cost if wrong: about 5 lines; another affordance would need a spec decision.
- Ruling: The drawer gets tabs in `layout.ts`, Spline and Cross-section.
  - `PageLayout.drawer` is replaced by `drawerTabs`; `openDrawer(tab)` takes the tab; `drawerTab` and `onDrawerChange(fn)` are new.
  - `onDrawerChange` fires after an open, a close or, while open, a tab switch.
  - The drawer tab is not stored, like the drawer's open state.
  - A tab that comes on screen catches up: the spline drawer is re-opened on its leaf (render and statistics request), and the cross-section requests if settled.
  - The Spline tab shows `No spline open: press Edit on a spline in the Parameters tab` until a spline opens. `drawer.ts` hides its body and actions until `open()`.
  - `openSpline` now opens the leaf before showing the drawer. Otherwise the drawer change would first request statistics for the leaf shown before.
- Ruling: Requests follow Task 22's rule.
  - When: on `onSettled`, with `settled = true` because the driver's status still reads unsettled there; when the tab comes on screen; when a line is set.
  - Only if the drawer is open on the Cross-section tab, no gesture is active and a line is set.
  - At most once per (session epoch, line). Each request carries a token, so the result for a line replaced in the meantime is dropped even at the same epoch.
  - `setLine` with a different line drops the shown profile and the pending request.
  - JobCancelled stays stale silently; any other error shows the warn notice `cross-section failed: <message>`.
  - Fresh means the result's epoch equals the draft's and no gesture is active; otherwise the profile is stale. With no profile for this line the state is `none`. This is the share chart's state rule.

  Cost if wrong: the same as Task 22's.
- Ruling: The plot.
  - Axes: distance from A in blocks on x; blocks on y. The y range covers offset0, offset ± σ, the water and lake levels and sea level, padded by 5 % (at least 4 blocks) and widened to whole blocks.
  - The ground is filled under offset. offset ± σ is a translucent band around the offset line, and offset0 is a thin dashed line.
  - Water above the ground is filled from the ground to its level, widened by half a point spacing so a one-point run shows. It comes in two kinds: water at sea level (the ocean, and river channels below 63) and lakes, where the lake level is finite. Each lake is labelled `lake L`. Sea level 63 is a dashed line.
  - River channels and gorges are translucent stripes with a marker triangle on the top edge.
  - jag gets its own strip under the axis, from 0 to the next power of two from 8, because it is an amplitude, not a height.
  - A and B are labelled at the plot's ends, and a legend follows the plot.
  - Hovering shows a cursor line and a readout of the nearest point: distance, x and z, offset0, offset ± σ, jag, the water above the ground and its depth, and the flags.
  - A summary line under the header gives the offset range, the share of the line under water, and the counts of river channels, gorges and lakes, with the lake levels.

  The section exposes `data-state`, `aria-busy`, and `data-point` on the readout. Cost if wrong: the DOM file and CSS only.
- Ruling: Texts are pinned by the unit tests:
  - the summary;
  - the readout;
  - the four statuses, plus `no line: press Cut line in the toolbar, then click A and B on the map`;
  - the tool's button labels and tips;
  - the refusals `cut line: A (x, z) is outside the world window` and `cut line: B is in the same block as A; click another point`;
  - the segment text `A (x, z) → B (x, z) · N blocks`.
- Ruling: Files.
  - The feature gets its own directory, `src/ui/crossSection/`, with `model.ts` (pure, unit-tested), `section.ts` (DOM, covered by the Chrome check) and `section.css`.
  - The tool's model lives with the tab's, because the page, the toolbar and the canvas all use it.
  - `ui/crossSection` imports `countText` from `ui/biomeTable/model` and the plot helpers from `ui/splineEditor/model`.

  Cost if wrong: file moves.
